sources.text: No source recorded for how it is made yet.

steps.note: Cream with vanilla is heated until it just bubbles at the edges.
The hot cream is poured in slowly while whisking, so the yolks do not scramble.
The strained custard is divided among ramekins.
Baked in a water bath halfway up the ramekins until set with a slight wobble.
Cooled for about an hour, then chilled uncovered for at least 4 hours until firm.

steps.name: burn sugar top
steps.note: Sugar is sprinkled on and caramelised with a torch or a very hot grill.

sources.text: The cream and yolk custard, its baking in a water bath, the chilling and the burnt sugar top, from these.
